notes: The smallest tide: two bars in 4/4, a breath in (third, fourth, fifth, held) and a breath out (down by step to the home note). Hymn-like; it says the most when it is said slowly. Winter: D minor, the theme in augmentation over open fifths, a bowed high line, and an inverted fragment to close.
